summary: Frontend-only landing regression and visual verification completed on public preview URL. Reported AI section washout is fixed with exact navy surface and readable typography; desktop side benefits rails fill hero side space as requested and remain responsive.

integration_issues.issue: Repeated net::ERR_ABORTED entries observed during rapid cross-route automation navigations (faculty/testimonials/faqs/sounds/cdn-cgi requests). Not user-visible in this pass; likely navigation-abort noise in test harness.

action_items: No landing functional/UI blocker found for this user report; safe for user visual confirmation.
Optional perf follow-up: monitor Three.js preserveDrawingBuffer path because browser GL warnings mention ReadPixels stalls under automation screenshots.
critical_code_review_comments: AI edge section now safely overrides legacy transparent-section rule using `.vv-immersive section.vvi-ai-edge { background: #02073D !important; }`, preventing inherited washout in both themes.
Desktop side rails are properly scoped to `@media (min-width: 1200px)` and hidden below 1200, matching desktop-only requirement without mobile growth regressions.
Landing style isolation remains intact: navigation to /login and /courses shows no lingering `.vv-immersive` node or `landing-active` body/html classes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://fintech-mvp-38.preview.emergentagent.com with required screenshot sizes only (1920x800 and 390x844). AI section computed styles: background rgb(2,7,61), heading rgb(245,241,255), all 6 tool labels rgb(245,241,255) in light+dark and desktop+mobile. Contrast measured: heading 17.18, description 9.95, kicker 9.05 (all pass thresholds). Desktop rails visible and non-overlapping at 1200/1280/1440/1920; hidden without overflow at 1199/1024/768/390/320. Hero scene interactive (mode switches, pause/reset, canvas present), CTA routes validated, side rail links scroll to #practice and #how-it-works.
rca of the issue: User-reported washed-out AI section originated from broad legacy rule in landing-dark.css forcing section backgrounds transparent (`.landing-light section, .landing-dark section { background: transparent !important; }`). The immersive CSS now adds a scoped override for AI band background, restoring intended dark surface and text contrast while keeping changes limited to landing/immersive scope.
